## JARVIS Voice v1 - the JARVIS screen
The page at https://jarvis.<server>.sslip.io (password protected) sends your words here. JARVIS answers the screen at once; approvals go to your Telegram with buttons.
JARVIS reads its recent activity from the data table **jarvis_memory** (columns kind, summary) before answering.
Setup: *Webhook* -> Header Auth credential **JARVIS screen key**. **OmniRoute** in both *Call* nodes. **JARVIS Telegram** in *Ask owner to approve* and *Reply on Telegram*. Save, then Publish.
